title: Anacardium Orientale
text: This remedy is characterized by a general state of mental and physical debility, with a marked loss of memory and a feeling of being divided into two personalities. It is useful in cases of nervous exhaustion and digestive disturbances. The characteristic symptom is a feeling of a plug in various parts of the body and a marked improvement of symptoms from eating. Loss of memory. Confused. Irritable. Feeling as if there were two wills, one commanding and the other forbidding. Fears. Aversion to work. Headache, with a sensation of a plug in the head. Vertigo. Scalp feels tight. Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision. Sensation of a plug in the eyes. Deafness. Tinnitus. Sensation of a plug in the ears. Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Sensation of a plug in the nose. Expression of pain and anxiety. Pale and sallow. Sensation of a cobweb on the face. Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky. Foul breath. Dryness and rawness in the throat. Sensation of a plug in the throat. Difficulty in swallowing. Appetite poor, but symptoms are better while eating and after eating. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Distended with gas. Rumbling. Flatulence. Chronic constipation. Sensation of a plug in the abdomen. Constipation. Stool large and hard. Sensation of a plug in the rectum. Much straining, even with soft stool. Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine. Menses profuse and early. Leucorrhoea. Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of a plug in the larynx. Stiffness and aching in the back. Sensitiveness of the spine to touch. Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Trembling of the hands. Numbness and tingling. Itching and burning. Dry and scaly. Eruptions like miliary rash. Intensely itching eczema. Worse in the morning and from mental labor. Better while eating and after eating. Compare: Rhus toxicodendron; Cypripedium; Chelidonium. Third to thirtieth potency.
